cues.text: You come in through the dorm's front door, your bag over your shoulder. Fuuka, Yukari, Mitsuru, Akihiko and Junpei sit around the table in the lounge in silence; Fuuka, Yukari and Mitsuru look downcast.
The front door opens and Ikutsuki, the chairman, walks over to the group, smiling.
Mitsuru gets up from the sofa and walks out of the lounge. Yukari stands up, startled, and watches her go.
